app_behavior.rule: This pin is the authority for native behavior only. A branch name is never sufficient evidence for a public claim.

privacy_claims.publication_rule: A privacy change may be published only after the pinned notice has completed the required content review and its digest is recorded here.

attestation_record.station_policy_evidence: Owner attestation in the current Codex task: the live 30-day and 90-day station retention claims are accurate.
attestation_record.tester_program_evidence: Owner attestation in the current Codex task: the live 90-day tester-program retention claim is accurate.

attested_accurate_claims.served_claim: For verified deletion requests, 24seven.FM deletes or anonymizes personally identifiable account and profile data from active systems within 30 days.
Favorites and account preferences are deleted with the account within the same period.
Ordinary song-request records, operational logs, Chat and forum data, and normal diagnostics/server/IP logs are kept for no more than 90 days.
Encrypted backups are retained for no more than 90 days.

The coordinator stops program access promptly after a verified withdrawal request and deletes or anonymizes private tester intake, assignments, feedback, and invitation correspondence within 90 days of a verified withdrawal, deletion request, rejection, or program-close decision.

unattested_served_claims.served_claim: A record may be retained only while an active security, abuse, fraud, or rule-enforcement investigation requires it; investigation records are deleted when no longer required and are kept for no more than one year.

required_scopes: station retention, deletion, and supported privacy-request contact
tester-program retention, deletion or anonymization, and mailbox handling
operational_attestation.rule: The retention attestation is recorded separately from confirmation of the supported privacy-request contact. Before a public privacy release, the designated owner must confirm every required scope; if any served numerical claim is inaccurate, the attestation must list that exact served route and wording before an interim correction and its separately approved release evidence are allowed.

interim_correction.rule: Use only after a named owner attests that a specific currently served claim is inaccurate. Every affected claim must exactly match an entry in the attestation's attested_inaccurate_claims list and retain exact wording, separate production approval, validation, and rollback evidence; this path is intentionally independent of the full replacement gate.

privacy_publication_gate.rule: A public privacy release must use --require-public-privacy-ready and remains blocked until the native notice and tester-program addendum are reviewed, legacy surfaces have a recorded disposition, an approved replacement source exists, and the owner attestation is recorded.

production_review_status.public_statement: The first production release is under review by Google Play and is not yet available for public installation.
production_review_status.scope_rule: This status attests only the review state and public unavailability. It does not identify a version, assert artifact provenance, or authorize publication.

non_authoritative_status_records.reason: The statement names neither an exact version nor a signed artifact. It cannot govern a public release claim.

non_authoritative_status_records.claim: current Google Play closed test is live
non_authoritative_status_records.reason: The statement names neither an exact version nor a signed artifact. It cannot govern a public release claim.
The statement is unversioned and conflicts with other unversioned status narrative. It cannot govern a public release claim.

release_claims.publication_rule: A recorded read-only Play Console observation is sufficient only for an availability claim about its exact version and track. Artifact provenance is sufficient only for a code-content claim about its exact version. A compound availability-and-content claim requires both gates. The owner-attested production-review record may state only that the first production release is under review and not yet publicly available; it cannot override those version-specific gates.

portal_surface.rule: This pin owns protected portal implementation only. It does not define native behavior, privacy text, or app release facts.

deployment.rule: A live artifact must be identified by a deployment manifest containing its source commit, artifact digest, verification record, and rollback reference; it is never inferred from branch names or similar markup.
